item.description: ### Fixed - **Amp usage reads the new two-pool sentence.** Amp reworded its usage summary when it split subscriptions into an agent pool and an orb pool, and Perch's Amp strip kept showing a stale reading (one account sat at "Other 99%" for two days while Amp itself said 26% used). The strip now shows the agent and orb pools by name, with the billing period's real end date. - **A session that hit its usage limit no longer spins as "active".** When a batch of background agents died on a rate limit, Claude Code never told Perch they had stopped, so the row kept a spinner and counted as active for up to thirty minutes after Claude was already back at its prompt. Perch now reads each agent's own transcript and drops the ones the API killed.
